notes: No state meal-period requirement for adults in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.
Minors: Wisconsin sets no hour limits for 16-17 (the former DWD 270.11 limits were repealed by CR 26-015, eff. 2026-06-01); 16-17 may not work during required school hours (Wis. Stat. § 103.68(1)).
Minors: no minor under 18 may work more than 6 consecutive hours without a 30-minute meal period (§ 103.68(3)); not encoded (no minor-break rule type). Extra param key max_days_week.

Tipped minimum wage: $2.33 cash wage (DWD 272.03(2)(a)); max_tip_credit 4.92 = $7.25 − $2.33. The employer needs a signed tip declaration each pay period. Effective date = date first seen in force (the rule text gives no start date).

rules.summary: During a school week, minors under 16 may work at most 3 hours on a school day, 8 on a non-school day, 18 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Wis. Stat. § 103.68 — Hours of labor for minors
citation.excerpt: (a) For more than 3 hours on a school day or 8 hours on a nonschool day. (b) For more than 18 hours in a school week or 40 hours in a nonschool week.

rules.summary: During a non-school week, minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day, 40 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Wis. Stat. § 103.68 — Hours of labor for minors
citation.excerpt: Before 7:00 a.m. or after 7:00 p.m. from the day after Labor Day to May 31. (e) Before 7:00 a.m. or after 9:00 p.m. from June 1 to Labor Day.

rules.summary: Wisconsin's tipped minimum cash wage is $2.33 an hour (opportunity employees under 20: $2.13), with tips making up the rest of the minimum wage.

citation.title: Wis. Admin. Code DWD 272.03(2)(a) — Minimum rates for tipped employees
citation.excerpt: Minimum rates for tipped employees. All employees except opportunity employees $2.33 per hr. DWD 272.03(2)(am) (am) Opportunity employees. Opportunity employees $2.13 per hour.
